idea-plugin.name: Phantom Log Console
idea-plugin.description: Readable logs in Run and Debug consoles: a JSON log line (logstash-logback-encoder, ECS, Log4j2 JSON) is shown as time LEVEL [thread] logger : message with its MDC values and the stack trace below it; plain text WARN, ERROR and DEBUG lines take their level's console color; a trace id (traceId=, JSON, the Spring Boot [traceId-spanId] and Sleuth patterns) is a link that lists every console line of that request.
